name: Heathen Tribe Ages, Dies and Has Children
description: Every Heathen ages, as believers do -- the camp's Heathens, villagers who left your tribe, and the puzzle Heathens too (the Heathen Doctor, the Heathen Chief, the three Heathen Masters and the Heathen Mommy) -- and can die of old age by exactly the believers' rule. They still never eat, starve or fall sick. When a camp Heathen dies, a new one joins the camp at once in the same camp role and mask; a puzzle Heathen whose puzzle is not solved yet is replaced by a new one in the same role, set up as the game sets that role up (the Heathen Mommy with her infant), so every puzzle can still be solved; a solved puzzle's Heathen never comes back. **A villager who left your tribe is not replaced when they die**, so defections never grow the camp. Heathen couples now and then have children (about once in 20 years for each woman from 14 to 45 with a man in the camp), only while at least 10 places stay free for your own village's babies; a Heathen child grows up in the camp. **Once The Last Heathen is solved no new Heathen comes from this patch at all** -- nobody is replaced and no Heathen baby is conceived or born (a pregnancy already started waits, as in the stock game) -- so the camp empties over time; and **with no Heathen alive none is ever made**. Island events, Barrel O' Babies and the other ways the game adds Heathens work as before. **What is left when a Heathen dies is decided by "All Heathens Leave Skeletons" or "Former Villagers Among the Heathens Leave Skeletons"**; with neither they simply disappear from the camp, no grave. Deaths go in the Deaths log, each replacement in the Births log's Arrived records, and each Heathen baby's conception and birth in the Births and Conceptions log, every one marked as a Heathen. **Heathens never count in the Village Statistics.** **With "Former Villagers Keep Aging Among the Heathens" also ticked, this covers everyone: nobody ages twice.** **Not yet seen in a running game** (checked by emulation of the stock executable). The companion is "VVFP Heathen Aging.dll"; it keeps its own small file per save, never writes a save.
behavior_changes: The age credit 0x46FE90 adds a living aging Heathen's units to its age +0x1B8C, as 0x46F7F0 does for a believer (0x470077); every other Heathen as the stock game (no age).

The life tick 0x472C90 gives an aging Heathen one unit for each unit of its age not yet processed (+0x1C3C), live and in the load-time catch-up, a Time Warp and a time skip (all of them come through the age credit and the life tick): at each whole year of the processed age past 1,100 + 160 x (Medicine - 1) units (the tech level read at 0x51D5D0, as 0x423600(1) reads it), rand(100) < 10 x the years over takes them -- the believers' old-age rule (0x472FC6..0x47304A). Nothing else of a believer's unit runs: no eating, starving, sickness, health, Faith drift, job or offline job ticks.

A death: with a skeleton row covering them, SetHealth 0x4758B0(0, 2 Old age) makes the body the believers' "Burying the dead" (0x46F130, 0x473F50) buries into the Roster of the Dead 0x464C70, as a believer's; the Village Statistics' death counter 0x51D3A0 is put back; a puzzle Heathen's body gets role 0 so the role finder 0x470690 finds the new one. Otherwise the activity stops (0x473440), the selection is dropped when it is theirs (0x4653D0, 0x470800), the presence byte +0x1CD4 is cleared, health untouched, and the Cause of Death companion writes the Death record (VvfpCauseDiedAmongHeathens: Old age, "no grave (died among the Heathens: nothing was left)").

The replacement, in the same tick, by the Heathen creator 0x46FD20 (Faith 1 there, so its SetFaith never runs to-a-Heathen; the stock camp's Faith written to +0x1CF0 after: -38 - rand(30), or the dead one's own when it was one of the five easy blue Faiths -5, -9, -16, -23, -30 of 0x470E60): an ordinary Heathen in the dead one's camp role (0..11) and mask (+0x1CED orange, +0x1CEE red), age 400, random sex; a former villager (no puzzle role) never replaced, and nobody once The Last Heathen (puzzle 25) is solved (the owner, 2026-11-23); a puzzle Heathen (roles 12-17) whose puzzle (1, 16, 13, 9, 5, 17: progress 0x51E008 + 8p against 0x51DF30 + 4p) is unsolved by the stock camp's own set-up of that role (0x424AC0; the Heathen Mommy's as the restored puzzle makes her, with her infant 0x465E00 forced, its father an adult Heathen man when there is one). A full table: owed until a record is free, kept in the slot's own file (each owed replacement with its role, masks and Faith), so a quit or a Change Tribe never loses or moves it; with no Heathen alive, or once The Last Heathen is solved, it is dropped. The Cause of Death companion writes its Arrived record (VvfpCauseHeathenArrived).

Who turned Heathen: a living Heathen the age credit last saw as that very believer (any path: the Faith drift, island events, The Spa, The Cracked Mask, a Custom Island Event; no call site spliced), by identity (name, likes, dislikes; carried to the new identity when the likes change in place or the name changes), kept per save slot in "Virtual Villagers Fun Patcher\Save <S>\Data\Heathen Aging\Heathen Aging - Save <S>.dat"; one who turned before the row by the parents on the record (+0x1BC0 / +0x1BD9).

Heathen babies: an aging Heathen woman (+0x1B90 1) aged 280-900 units, not expecting, not the Heathen Mommy (role 17), with a living adult Heathen man, conceives on rand(400) == 0 each unit through 0x465E00 forced (father a random adult Heathen man), only while more than 10 records are free and The Last Heathen (puzzle 25) is unsolved; the twins and triplets counters 0x51D380 / 0x51D384 are put back. 40 units later (+0x1C4C + 0x28 < processed age, the stock birth's rule) each baby is made by 0x46FD20 at age 40, a Heathen, with the parents' names, heads and bodies on its record (+0x1BC0, +0x1BD9, +0x1BF4..+0x1C00; the head the stock birth's rule, the parents' average +-1 on 95%), then the pregnancy and the carry (0x466420(-1)) are cleared. A pregnancy from before a woman turned Heathen, and the Heathen Mommy's infant, wait for her to rejoin the tribe, as in the stock game.
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion splices two sites at run time, only after verifying their stock bytes, all or none; each splice makes the very instructions it replaced.
A Heathen still never eats, starves, falls sick, loses health, drifts in Faith, works or uses the work system.
Heathens never count in the Village Statistics: the death counter is put back, the Oldest Villager maximum skips them where the statistics rows say so, a Heathen mother's babies are not counted.
Nothing is written to a save. Without the Cause of Death companion, nothing is logged.

runtime_detours.routine: the age credit 0x46FE90's faction test `cmp byte [esi+0x1CEC], bl; mov edi, eax; jne` (the Village Statistics rows' form, `jne` 38, accepted too): a believer goes on to the stock add 0x470081; an aging Heathen gets the same units added to +0x1B8C and takes the branch the executable has there (0x47008D, or 0x4700B9 past the Oldest Villager maximum with the statistics); any other Heathen that branch alone
